data.title: Fidelity Just Filed to Let Its Crypto Ethereum ETF Stake 100% of Its Holdings
data.description: FD Funds Management LLC, sponsor of the Fidelity Crypto Ethereum Fund (FETH), filed a pre-effective amendment to its Form S-3 registration statement with the U.S. SEC on July 24, 2026, adding disclosure that would let the fund stake up to 100% of its ether (ETH) holdings.
